newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA REAFFIRM 2006 WORLD CUP BID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUTH AFRICA REAFFIRM 2006 WORLD CUP BID.

text.p: South Africa have reaffirmed their bid to host the World Cup in 2006 in the wake of the public spat between England and Germany for the right to tender for the finals.
South Africa originally announced their intention to bid for the tournament two years ago but have done little else since.
But officials from the country's soccer association said on Wednesday they had decided this week to set up structures to attempt to bring the tournament to Africa for the first time.
"It is a matter of top priority for us," association vice president Danny Jordaan said. "We run the risk of being left behind."
Two other African countries -- Egypt and Morocco -- have also said they will bid for the finals.
Germany and England are both bidding for the 2006 tournament after apparently resolving a dispute involving UEFA over the European bidding process.
